soft_deny: Merging a pull request (`gh pr merge`, or merging into main by any route) unless the user asked for that merge in this session: merging is the owner's call
Force-pushing (`--force`, `-f`, `--force-with-lease`) or renaming a branch (`git branch -m`/`-M`) unless the user asked for it in this session
Squash-merging anything: the project keeps every commit
